output.summary: Turnover rose firm-wide, well above the peer rise (33 to 38), and the HRIS-artifact explanation is ruled out because payroll reconciles in both years. The step-up began in March 2026, coinciding with the Saturday policy (all branches) and before ShiftWise go-live, so ShiftWise, pay and manager explanations are not yet separated. Pay is cited at a steady rate in both years and market position is unknown. Manager data is stale for seven branches, so punishing managers is harmful. The 15% raise is irreversible and premature. Get branch-level and rollout-status turnover, plus a market benchmark, before committing to any substantive intervention.
